queer_characters.name: Agnes (and other archival case study subjects)
queer_characters.notes: The documentary centers on transgender clients from Harold Garfinkel's 1950s UCLA gender clinic case studies, portrayed through reenactments by transgender actors within a historical framing of trans icons and identity.

queer_creators.name: Chase Joynt
queer_creators.notes: Directed this documentary centering transgender histories; the source text describes the trans-focused approach but does not explicitly state Joynt's own identity, so this is an inference and should be verified by the maintainer.

contributor_notes: Source text lists trigger warnings for historical medical gatekeeping/pathologization of trans identities and transphobia.
